author: Keystone Today
title: York man sentenced to 210 months for firearm and drug offenses related to child's death
text:
Adrian Moye, age 34, of York, Pennsylvania, was sentenced on May 12 to 210 months in prison for possessing a firearm as a previously convicted felon and possessing cocaine with intent to distribute, according to the United States Attorney’s Office for the Middle District of Pennsylvania.
The sentencing follows an incident on August 20, 2019, when Moye left a five-year-old boy unattended in a vehicle parked on East Philadelphia Street in York. A loaded handgun belonging to Moye was also left inside the vehicle. The gun was accidentally discharged, resulting in the death of the child. Authorities said that Moye was prohibited from having firearms due to previous felony convictions that included drug-trafficking offenses. Investigators later determined that he also possessed cocaine intended for distribution.
United States Attorney Brian D. Miller said that law enforcement agencies including the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives (ATF) and the York City Police Department investigated the case. Assistant United States Attorney Carlo D. Marchioli prosecuted it.
The U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Middle District of Pennsylvania prosecutes federal crimes and manages civil cases across a jurisdiction covering 33 counties and serving about 3.2 million residents; it also offers victim support and reentry programs designed to aid rehabilitation and community safety, according to the official website .
The office operates under the United States Department of Justice with facilities located in Harrisburg, Scranton, Williamsport and Wilkes-Barre within its coverage area spanning over 21,900 square miles throughout central Pennsylvania. according to its official website
Moye’s sentence underscores ongoing efforts by federal authorities in promoting public safety through prosecution of violent crime offenders while supporting initiatives like Project Safe Neighborhoods. according to information from their official site
